### Mastercard Incorporated to Host Conference Call on Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


October 8, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/479285134/files/doc_news/Mastercard-Incorporated-to-Host-Conference-Call-on-Third-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-2026.pdf)


PURCHASE, N.Y.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


On Thursday, October 29, 2026, Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE: MA) will release its third quarter 2026 financial results. The company will host a conference call to discuss these results at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time.


The financial results will be posted on the company’s website at[investor.mastercard.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.mastercard.com%2Finvestor-relations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54618191&newsitemid=20261008087436&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.mastercard.com&index=1&md5=1d6435b66e100c47cda0687c1e2db2b8) . The company will issue an alert over a news wire when the earnings materials are publicly available, including a link to those documents.


**Conference Call Details:** North America Toll-free: +1 833 461 5787
International Toll: +1 585 542 9983
International Dial-Ins:[https://help.events.q4inc.com/eahc/international-dial-in-numbers](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fhelp.events.q4inc.com%2Feahc%2Finternational-dial-in-numbers&esheet=54618191&newsitemid=20261008087436&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fhelp.events.q4inc.com%2Feahc%2Finternational-dial-in-numbers&index=2&md5=db2f52b7ba7830b888a2f704fc456e60)
Meeting ID: 262177588


A replay of the call will be available for 30 days and can be accessed below:
US Local: +1 929 828 5978
US Local Toll free: +1 833 309 1852
Passcode: 262177588


A webcast for this call can also be accessed at[investor.mastercard.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.mastercard.com%2Finvestor-relations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54618191&newsitemid=20261008087436&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.mastercard.com&index=3&md5=3871d688b540a9c95fa327e2cbc999f3) .
